shots.content: Light-skinned woman at the mirror, dull, with a grey dullness cloud. The tube mascot on the counter stands on sneakers (no wide cap).
shots.note: L1 'Morning skin drama again?' (spoken by the tube) plays over Meera's dull, flat, yellowish-looking before-skin. She sighs and touches her cheek. Use 0-3.6 s.

shots.content: Tube mascot close-up with the flip-top cap OPEN showing a nozzle, and a finger below.
shots.note: PSA2_avatar_point slowed to 0.93x for 5.37 s. New L2 'Relax. My purple sits opposite yellow, so it cancels dullness.' plays as the mascot points right and a CORRECT animated wheel appears (purple directly opposite yellow; arrow; yellow dims).

shots.content: Woman with an UNBLENDED lavender patch on her cheek, a grey cloud villain, and the capless mascot beside her.
shots.note: L3 'Blend me in. Made for Indian skin, no cast.' plays as Meera blends the lavender until it disappears into her dusky skin with no cast, and it turns dewy. Use 0-3.93 s.

shots.content: Light-skinned woman smiling in the mirror (the 'after').
shots.note: New L4 'Protected. Instant glow. Ready.' plays over Meera's visibly even, dewy, glowing skin, framed like the before shot (S1), so it reads as a real before/after. Use 0-2.93 s.

shots.content: Tube mascot on sneakers (no cap) on a balcony table, with the woman's torso behind it.
shots.note: L5 'Instant glow, then go.' plays as Meera on a sunny balcony laughs with the ONE exact tube mascot and touches her glowing cheek, the same balcony setting as before. Use 0-4.2 s.

summary: Every shot had a capless or nozzle mascot, a non-dusky woman or an unblended patch. The new sequence is PS07 dull, colour-wheel graphic, PS05 blend, PS06 instant glow, then PSA3 Meera + mascot, so before, application, blend and glow are all visible. L2 now explains purple vs yellow, 'Instant Glow' is said twice, and the tube voice becomes female.
